## InvenTree OpenAPI specification

**File:** `docs/InvenTree API.yaml`
**Upstream:** https://github.com/inventree/InvenTree
**Version:** InvenTree API v530
**Licence:** MIT
**Modified:** No — included verbatim as generated by InvenTree.

Redistributed here because the test suite reads it: the InvenTree stub server
in `tests/support.py` derives its set of valid routes from this file, so a call
to a route the real server does not expose fails loudly instead of passing
against a permissive mock.

MIT is compatible with GPL-3.0, so this file may be redistributed as part of
this project provided the notice below travels with it.

## DigiKey API specifications and data — deliberately not included

No DigiKey specification, documentation or data is distributed with this
project, and none may be added.

Under the [DigiKey API User Agreement](https://developer.digikey.com/api-user-agreement):

- §3.2(iii) prohibits publishing, distributing or otherwise making available
  the API or Documentation.
- §4 classes the Documentation as Confidential Information.
- §3.2(iv) prohibits distributing or disclosing DigiKey Data to third parties.
- §9 requires all DigiKey Data to be deleted on termination of the agreement.

This is enforced by `.gitignore` in two places: `docs/digikey-api/*.json` for
the specifications, and `.cache` plus the `--json` output filenames for
responses retrieved at runtime. See `docs/digikey-api/README.md` for how to
obtain the specifications for your own local use.

DigiKey is a trademark of Digi-Key Corporation. This project is not affiliated
with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Digi-Key Corporation.
